statement: For running negative excursions, strict locality and useful endpoint gluing pull in opposite directions: leaving the complement uncontrolled blocks local-to-global transport, while certifying it small makes the cutoff an effective endpoint and Q-control sufficient for terminal downside.
reusable_boundary: This obstruction applies to extrema that dominate the cutoff value. It must not be generalized to arbitrary non-extremal internal statistics without a fresh relation proof.

repeated_failure_links.relation: same complement conservation; R8 classifies the other branch when the complement is successfully controlled
same structural phenomenon: a negligible complement can collapse an apparent surrogate distinction
same local-to-global rule: complement/order cannot be silently deleted
